title: Implement RC-verification-marker-write-path-fix (Cluster H, rows 35/36)
determination: Fixed _write_candidate_verification_marker (readme_refresh_run.py) to hash the candidate's real on-disk bytes (Path.read_bytes()) instead of the newline-translated `text` string -- Path.read_text()'s universal-newline translation silently normalized CRLF to LF before hashing, so the recorded hash never matched the file's actual bytes on a CRLF-checked-out candidate (row 36). Also fixed the audit-only write path (run_id=None, called from audit_portfolio) to preserve a prior bound run's verified_by_run_id when the content it is re-confirming is unchanged, only resetting to None when content genuinely changed or no prior marker exists -- previously audit_portfolio's own periodic sweeps unconditionally clobbered a real ingest_candidate/recheck run's provenance (row 35). Updated _candidate_drift_findings to compare against the same raw-bytes hash basis for consistency (removed its now-unused text parameter, updated its one call site). 4 new failing-first regression tests added and verified (test_write_candidate_verification_marker_hashes_real_bytes_not_newline_translated_text, test_candidate_drift_findings_no_false_positive_on_crlf_candidate, test_audit_only_marker_write_preserves_prior_run_id_when_content_unchanged, test_audit_only_marker_write_resets_run_id_when_content_changed). Full scoped test suite across all 3 readme-refresh test files (845 tests) passes with zero regressions.
evidence_refs: scripts/pipeline/tests/test_readme_refresh_scope.py (3 call sites updated for the signature change, all passing)
reports/plan_state/readme-refresh-forensic-trust-audit-2026-08-25/taskcards.jsonl (RC-verification-marker-write-path-fix, remains TODO in the closed audit mission by design)

title: Implement Navigation TOC parity hard gate (Phase 4 row 22, part of phase6b II-b cheap wins)
determination: Added check_navigation_toc_matches_headings (readme_refresh_checks.py) -- a new hard gate parsing the Navigation section's own linked heading list (- [Text](#anchor) bullets, matched on link text per the real portfolio's own convention) and diffing it against the document's real ## headings. Flags both a missing_from_navigation finding (a real heading with no matching Navigation entry -- confirmed live on note/python's own candidate for its Dependencies section, and 8 other products, 9/31 = 29% per the audit) and an orphaned_navigation_entry finding (a stale Navigation link naming a heading that no longer exists). No-ops (returns []) when no '## Navigation' section exists at all, since Navigation is not itself a required section. Wired into _run_deterministic_checks (readme_refresh_run.py) as hard_gate=True. 6 new regression tests added and verified. The shared _GOOD_CANDIDATE test fixture in test_readme_refresh_run.py had an incomplete Navigation section (only listed 1 of its 9 real H2 headings) -- fixed the fixture itself to be a genuinely complete/valid candidate under the new rule, which is the correct resolution (not weakening the new check). Full scoped test suite (845 tests) passes with zero regressions.
evidence_refs: reports/repo-presenter-regen-full/note/python/readme.md:12-23,81 (the real, live instance this check now catches -- Dependencies heading missing from Navigation; not modified by this mission)

title: Stage 1a cheap wins: Navigation TOC parity hard gate + Cluster H write-path marker fix
determination: Implements phase6b section II-b in full, and both sub-fixes of the audit mission's RC-verification-marker-write-path-fix candidate. (1) check_navigation_toc_matches_headings: new hard gate flagging a real heading missing from Navigation and a stale Navigation entry with no matching heading; wired into _run_deterministic_checks. (2) _write_candidate_verification_marker now hashes the candidate's real on-disk bytes (open(path,'rb').read()) instead of Path.read_text()'s newline-translated string, fixing the CRLF hash-mismatch bug; audit_portfolio's run_id=None write now preserves a prior bound run's verified_by_run_id when the content it re-confirms is unchanged, instead of unconditionally clobbering it. 10 new regression tests; full scoped suite (test_readme_refresh_run.py, test_readme_refresh_checks.py, test_readme_refresh_scope.py): 845 passed, 0 regressions. Committed and pushed: e27719470b6706bb2bf4507ba77afda3f8f58ef7 (verified as ancestor of origin/main). Post-fix full-31-product audit-portfolio re-run confirmed the new check fires correctly on 9/31 products (3d/java, 3d/net, cells/cpp, cells/net, note/python, slides/net, slides/python newly dirty; pdf/net and tex/python gained it as an additional finding on top of pre-existing ones), with zero change to any other product's result -- proving no regression in unrelated checks.
